Answer ID: 9168 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2093/1924=D/1429) If your mother is sure that no drop pf milk went inside and she did not drink even a little quantity, then only by giving breast in mouth the raza?at (suckling) will not take place. But if there is some doubt, then it is better to avoid i.e. it is better to marry him with any other girl. If she is sure that even a drop of milk went inside her throat, then the raza?at (suckling) will take place and your brother will not be allowed to marry raza?ee sister (sister by suckling). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
